name: core-runtime-messaging-email-to-salesforce-handler-evidence

evidence.notes: The local runtime directly constructs a typed EmailToSalesforceHandler value.
The local runtime directly executes the zero-argument constructor.
The local runtime clones the handler into a distinct typed value.

source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeMessagingEmailToSalesforceHandlerEvidenceTest { @isTest static void rows() { Messaging.EmailToSalesforceHandler handler = new Messaging.EmailToSalesforceHandler(); Messaging.EmailToSalesforceHandler cloned = (Messaging.EmailToSalesforceHandler)handler.clone(); System.assertNotEquals(handler, cloned); } }

salesforceExclusionReason: EmailToSalesforceHandler construction and cloning are covered by deterministic local execution; this fixture makes no Salesforce parity claim.
